test_policy.notes: Freshmen must submit SAT, ACT or CLT scores (one is enough; SAT/ACT are superscored). Minimums: SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing 480 and Math 440; ACT English or Reading 17 and Math 17. Meeting the minimums does not guarantee admission.

requirements.notes: Apply on Augusta's own online application; $60 non-refundable (NACAC, College Board and ACT fee waivers accepted). Minimum 3.00 GPA recalculated on the 17 required high school courses (4 English, 4 math, 4 science, 3 social science, 2 foreign language). International applicants send official transcripts from every school; a NACES course-by-course evaluation is recommended, not required. Nursing applicants apply separately through NursingCAS. Enrollment deposit $200. International applicants should confirm acceptance at least 90 days before the semester starts to allow I-20 processing.

deadlines.notes: Decisions released on or before Nov 15, 2026. The page is headed 'Important Dates for 2027 Applications' and does not give separate international dates.

deadlines.notes: The international page says documents are due before the 'assigned application deadline' without listing a separate date.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived with graduation from a U.S. high school, completion of an approved University System of Georgia ESL program, a degree earned where English is the language of instruction, or English 1101/1102 with a C or better at an accredited U.S. institution. Alternative test minimums: SAT EBRW 480, ACT English 17, EIKEN Pre-1, MET 59, IGCSE/O-level English D, GCSE or GCE A-level English C. No conditional-admission or ESL pathway for first-year international applicants was found on the page.

english.notes: Page prints 4.0 for tests taken in 2026 or later.

cost.notes: Augusta cost of attendance 2026-27, on-campus: out-of-state tuition $24,568, fees $1,350, food $4,574, housing $8,564, books $1,330, loan fee $96, miscellaneous $3,078, transportation $1,828 = $45,388 (in-state total $27,954 with tuition $7,134). Other = loan fee + miscellaneous + transportation. The page does not name an international rate; out-of-state is assumed

aid.notes: No scholarship for international students and no rule on their eligibility was found. Augusta uses the Scholarship Universe portal (need, merit and talent awards); most institutional awards have a Feb 1 deadline and only admitted students can access it.
